text:
Houston Stadium — nke a maara dị ka NRG Stadium, na mbụ dị ka Reliant Stadium — e chepụtara ya maka rodeo na bọọlụ. Ihe owuwu malitere na Machị 9, 2000, e mechara ya na Ọktoba 2001, e wuchara ya n'ime ọnwa 30 na ego US$352 nde. Ọ mepere na Ọgọst 24, 2002 na egwuregwu preseason, Miami Dolphins meriri Houston Texans 24–3; egwuregwu NFL nke mbụ sochiri na Septemba 8, 2002, ndị Texans meriri Dallas Cowboys 19–10.

Ihe pụrụ iche nke ebe ahụ bụ injinia: ọ bụ ụlọ ọrụ NFL mbụ e wuru nwere ụlọ elu nwere ike imechi. Ogwe akwa abụọ na-ekewa na 50-yard line ma na-emeghe n'ime nkeji 7, e jiri ụkpụrụ kinetic-architecture chepụta ya site n'aka Populous (HOK Sport) tinyere Walter P Moore na Uni-Systems. Ebumnuche abụọ ahụ abụghị ihe echeghị echiche — onye nwe ya Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo, RodeoHouston, bụ akụkụ dị mkpa nke atụmatụ ahụ, e mere ụlọ ahụ iji jeere ndị na-ege ntị abụọ ozi.

Dị ka ebe obibi nke Houston Texans, ụlọ egwuregwu ahụ na-enye oche klọb karịrị 7,000 na ụlọ 186, yana ikike 72,220 nke nwere ike ịgbasa ruo ihe dị ka 80,000 maka ihe omume pụrụ iche. Ala ya agbanweela kemgbe afọ, site na sistemụ ahịhịa eke na mmalite ruo turf artificial na-adịgide adịgide arụnyere na 2015. Aha ahụ agbanwekwala: mepere dị ka Reliant Stadium, ọ ghọrọ NRG Stadium na 2014 n'okpuru ikike aha NRG Energy, wee were aha Houston Stadium maka 2026 World Cup, aha Reliant ga-alaghachi mgbe e mesịrị.

Na mgbakwunye na bọọlụ na rodeo, ụlọ ahụ anabatala ụfọdụ ihe omume kachasị ibu na mba ahụ: Super Bowls XXXVIII na LI, 2024 College Football Playoff National Championship, na WrestleMania 25. 2026 World Cup bụ World Cup ụmụ nwoke mbụ ya, isi nke ikpeazụ maka ebe e kọwara ogologo oge site na ịdị iche iche na ọnụọgụ.
